crew.overview: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool battles the evil and powerful Cable and other bad guys to save a boy's life.
crew.title: Deadpool 2

crew.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
crew.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

crew.overview: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.
crew.title: The Fantastic 4: First Steps

crew.overview: Due to a genetic disorder, handsome librarian Henry DeTamble involuntarily zips through time, appearing at various moments in the life of his true love, the beautiful artist Clare Abshire.
crew.title: The Time Traveler's Wife

crew.original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
crew.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
crew.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

details.biography:
Jeremy B. Simser is an illustrator and storyboard artist, working in, but not limited to, Vancouver, BC. 

Some of his credits include The Flash, Supergirl, Deadpool 2, Game of Thrones, Amazing Stories, The Terror: Infamy, Jay and Silent Bob Reboot, The Great, The Boys, WandaVision, Doctor Strange In the Multiverse of Madness, and She-Hulk. Most recently, he was the lead stoyboard artist on Echo for Marvel Studios.

Simser enjoys collecting first edition Stephen King’s and his spare time, and he might be found doing lightsaber fight choreography.
details.name: Jeremy Simser
